profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Zelis
profile.summary:
I architect and deliver production platforms that transform how operational teams work. My focus is replacing manual processes with AI-assisted automation, consolidating legacy tooling into unified operational surfaces, and designing systems that work across global teams, production constraints, and business-critical workflows.

Currently, I lead technical strategy for AI-enabled data operations and cloud platform architecture at Zelis Healthcare.

My recent work spans four areas:
AI Strategy & Automation
I design and ship AI-powered operational systems that reduce multi-hour manual workflows to minutes. My working pattern is surgical AI insertion at high-value points: capture the operational artifact, generate structured configuration, keep humans in review, and execute deterministically. I avoid autonomous-agent designs where deterministic systems are faster, safer, cheaper, and easier to audit.

Cloud Infrastructure & Modernization
I helped architect the system design that enabled a major cloud migration across 24+ servers, 1,400+ databases, 100TB of data, and 400+ production scraping workloads. The platform modernized from dedicated VMs to orchestrated containers with auto-scaling, completed on schedule with no significant client impact, and helped ME&T become the first Zelis business unit fully in the cloud.

Platform Architecture
I architected and delivered DataOpsPulse, a unified operations platform for data harvesting visibility, job lifecycle tracking, AI-integrated workflows, and operational telemetry. After Pulse entered production, completed harvests increased 124% in one month with no team-size increase, giving operations and leadership a clearer control plane for work in flight.

Global Technical Leadership
I serve as a technical lead across distributed US and India teams. I set architectural direction, publish decision records, mentor engineers, create integration seams for partner teams, and enable global operations through tooling and system design rather than proximity.
I think about engineering as a business lever. I build systems, but I measure their economic and operational impact: throughput, reliability, cycle time, capacity, cloud efficiency, and the ability of teams to operate without institutional bottlenecks.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected DataOpsPulse, a platform for operational visibility, job lifecycle tracking, status mapping, and workflow telemetry across data harvesting operations.
- Defined and implemented AI-assisted configuration patterns using structured prompts, human review, and deterministic execution paths.
- Helped modernize data harvesting infrastructure from VM-oriented operation toward AWS/ECS containerized execution.
- Led executive-visible production escalations across scraper automation, SQL Server capacity, parsing performance, role permissions, and operational workflows.
- Partnered with US and India teams to improve harvesting throughput, operational diagnostics, and developer enablement.
- Authored architecture decision records for job modeling, operational status, AI configuration, time measurement, and recurring execution.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description:
• Researched, designed, and built tools for internal data operations team for data extraction and processing
• Designed architecture for an operations dashboard, created a framework for queuing system infrastructure
• Solved complex problems surrounding web scraping and bot detection, providing simple solutions to end users
• Developed open source HttpParser library that is used in Zelis applications
• Implemented DevOps strategy where there was none before
• Refactored monolithic legacy applications into microservices. Upgraded all legacy apps to .NET (core)
• Converted dozens of SQL UDF functions to SQL CLR to increase data throughput by 99.9+%
• Technical lead for high-impact server migration projects
• Go-to developer for mentoring interns and junior developers
• Liaison between offshore development team and Zelis Team Leads

positions.title: Founder & Engineer
positions.description:
Building B2B workflow automation products for small and mid-sized engineering firms and service businesses. Structra delivers operational software, including PropertyWorks, a job management platform for property service companies with a focus on eliminating manual coordination overhead through system design.

End-to-end ownership: product strategy, architecture, engineering, client delivery.

positions.title: Regional Systems Support Lead (Contractor for Department of Education)
positions.description:
•	Completed IT requests per service request procedures and documented resolutions in SLA
•	Provided local and remote desktop support
•	Working relationship with DoED and OCIO for server/network site migration

positions.title: Data Systems/Network Administrator
positions.description:
Assistant Data Chief
•	Led group of Marines in Al Anbar, Iraq through transition and support mission to successfully demobilize or transport hundreds of technology assets to Afghanistan or the United States

Networking Specialist/Information Security Coordinator
•	Selected over peers as Regimental Data Chief and Squad Leader of 20+ Marines
•	Hand‐picked by Commanding Officer as data systems  SME for Javelin Thrust 2011
•	Developed SharePoint trouble ticket system to track hundreds of IT incidents during OIF
•	Maintain Unit Website

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description: Provided specialized telephone support to field service dealers and end user customers as well as control quality of the account base through cut-in procedures. Additionally, provided backup support for data maintenance and programming support.  Dialer project responsibilities that may include the following: Resolved customer reprogramming needs and technical concerns by handling inbound and outbound calls.

positions.title: Network Provisioner
positions.description: Received VoIP requests from partner companies, requested telephone numbers to be released from CLECs, and validated addresses within a 911 Database. Position required attention to detail, following SOP, and work within SLA.
